summary: CCC-built 1938 open wooden tower in Cockaponset State Forest, Haddam CT; tower gone, concrete footings remain beside the Cockaponset Trail.

facts.design: 23-foot open wooden observation tower with a 10-foot square wooden platform; two sets of stairs with hand railings and one landing
facts.status_note: The tower is gone. Its concrete footings remain east of the Cockaponset Trail, just north of Jericho Road.

access.note: The footings lie in Cockaponset State Forest beside a marked hiking trail. No source describes a sign or marker at the spot.

visit.trail_note: East of the Cockaponset Trail, just north of Jericho Road

events.note: A forest fire burned on the site; the tower was later built there
Built July and August 1938 by Company 1195 of the CCC, based at Camp Filley; 71 man-days at a total cost of $282.43
Registered September 9, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts marks the tower Removed, while the register and the trail guide describe concrete footings still present. Both can be true: the tower is gone, its footings are not.

sources.title: Cockaponsett State Forest and Camp Filley
It's Like a Jungle Out There in Haddam

notes_for_editor: No source gives a removal date, so no removed event is recorded. No staffing or post-1938 fire history was found. Assumes the register's 23' is structure height (height_m 7.0). The 2009 Courant column and the undated CFPA trail guide are the only current-condition descriptions; a recent visit would confirm the footings. Haddam Historical Society spells the forest Cockaponsett; FFLOS and CFPA use Cockaponset. Living New Deal pages returned 403 and were not read.
